responsibility: Declares the mixed/operator-specialized portion of GCC’s range-operator framework, especially the range_operator subclasses and helper utilities used when ranger reasons about integer, pointer, floating, and boolean results across specific tree codes. This header provides shared helpers such as early relational resolution, zero/bitmask predicates, boolean-range state decoding, and the class declarations for operators like equality, comparisons, bitwise ops, min/max, and other mixed-mode cases that override fold_range, operand back-propagation, relation inference, and bitmask updating beyond the base interfaces in range-op.h.
